Game Overview

Bouncing Egg is a arcade title where guide a fragile egg through a vibrant pixel-art world, bouncing on rotating circles to smash menacing faces. With its simple tap controls and addictive gameplay, every moment demands precision, patience, and perfect timing. Can you master the escalating challenge and keep your egg intact?
